analysis.material: printed tin with paper-style label wrap
analysis.descriptor: a squat upright cylindrical tin with straight sides, thin gold rolled rims at top and bottom, and a flat lid; the smallest size has a clear translucent snap-on cap. the body is deep maroon, wrapped by an orange label shaped like an arch with a cream and gold outline that rises over the front. at the centre sits a round portrait of a blue-skinned youth with a crown and peacock feather inside a yellow circle, with a small curled ribbon banner at each side and a tiny arc of text above. below it is a red rectangular plate with bold white serif lettering, then two lines of yellow and white capital lettering. a small green-dot mark sits at upper right.
